steps.subject: sky

steps.subject: sky

steps.subject: structure

steps.subject: structure

steps.motion: straight in, work back and forth

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: flick upward for grassy tufts

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: indicate small tree trunks
steps.load: a little of the blue and white

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight the small tree

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: pop tiny snow-covered highlights on grass
steps.load: the smallest amount of liquid white
steps.rule: the dark underneath makes light touches show

steps.action: paint thin sticks and twigs against the tree

steps.action: cut through paint so black canvas shows as sticks
